result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It appropriately applies the cyber coverage because Licensor processes Licensee data. However, requiring all coverages to continue for one year after the term—including CGL and workers’ compensation—goes beyond the supplied playbook and is not necessary to reach the preferred position. The addition is otherwise standalone and professionally drafted without disturbing the representation-by-counsel provision.
